name: Confirm TOTP Enrollment
summary: The user submits one authenticator verification code; the server verifies the staged secret, enables TOTP, issues recovery codes, and the client transitions to the recovery-code view.

preconditions.expression: user is authenticated, TOTP enrollment is pending, and the authenticator can produce a current valid code

serverInteraction.intent: Verify the staged authenticator exactly once, enable TOTP, and return the newly issued recovery codes.

postconditions.expression: TOTP is enabled and fresh recovery codes have been issued for the current durable identity

sourceReferences.note: ConfirmTotpEnrollmentAsync is the single server operation for this scenario and returns the recovery codes displayed on the destination view.
